main_text.p: sum functus. D. Imò mea. Q. Utrius ductu gesta res sit. R. Quia meo imperio atque auspicijs, non autem tuis, gesta res est. Ductu autem eius geri res dicitur, cuius auspicijs, imperioque geritur. F. Imò eius, qui, cum scilicet in Imperio sit, ducis partes, altero iacente, fortiter ac prosperè administrat. D. Eius ne magistratus ductu geri res dicatur, qui dum maior magistratus, cuius imperio & auspicijs res gerebatur, iaceret, solus Imperatoris partibus est functus? Atque hoc quidem exemplū ex Valerio Maximo descripsimus. Sequitur alterum ex Ci-ce-

page.notes: Running head in heavy black-letter type at top, partly unreadable. Speaker names (D., Q., R., F.) are set inline within the running dialogue, so the passage is one paragraph continued from the previous page. Last line ends with a printed hyphen ("Ci-ce-"), which continues onto the next page. Handwritten annotation in the left margin at the bottom and the dot mark beside "administrat" are not printed text and were left out. Possible smudge near "Q." and "F." is uncertain but readable.
